views.rights: Independent research visualization; no official endorsement. City data terms remain applicable. Architectural design and source photographs retain separate rights. No source photographs, Street View pixels or private correspondence are included.

Artform
views.subtitle: 86 Dundas Street East · Approximate exterior · Rev03
views.summary: A completed-building exterior study informed by historical plans and dated photographs. April 2026 observations inform the warm masonry, frontage openings and recessed colonnade. Rev03 removes only exact duplicate opaque surfaces.
views.credit: Model study: Daniel Sultan / Future Mississauga. Architectural design: Studio JCI. Developer: EMBLEM. Reference photographs: Edward Skira and Tim MacDonald / UrbanToronto; Google Street View, April 2026.
views.limits: Passage depth, rear continuation, hidden faces and finished heights remain unverified. Zoning maxima are not measured as-built heights. Ground, interiors and surrounding site works are excluded; this standalone study is not a surveyed placement on the city map.
views.rights: Independent study; no architect, owner or photographer endorsement. Model geometry and generated views are separate from the architectural design and reference-image rights. Original photographs, Google image pixels and planning PDFs are not included.
